answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique identifier tied to a cryptographic proof-of-work. An attacker attempting to forge multiple identities will incur significant computational costs, similar to trying to bend a willow tree into a violet-colored shape. As the number of fake identities grows, so does the computational effort required to maintain them, making it economically infeasible for an attacker to create a large number of Sybil identities.
